subject.title: fix(extensions): bound JSON response reads to prevent OOM

question: After the stale slices are removed, should the remaining plugin paths use the shared 16 MiB fail-closed JSON response boundary?
rationale: The helper is the right owner-boundary primitive, but applying it to successful external-service responses can reject payloads that previously parsed, so maintainer intent is needed for the compatibility boundary.

options.title: Narrow And Review Remaining Paths
options.body: Drop the landed overlap and automation churn, then review the remaining bounded-read paths with changed-function proof and explicit cap acceptance.

options.title: Accept Broad Cap After Cleanup
options.body: Maintain the shared 16 MiB ceiling for all remaining paths once proof shows normal responses still parse and oversized responses fail predictably.

options.title: Split Or Close This Branch
options.body: Prefer smaller focused PRs for any remaining call sites if the current branch is too stale to rebase cleanly.

recommendation.title: Narrow And Review Remaining Paths
recommendation.body: Drop the landed overlap and automation churn, then review the remaining bounded-read paths with changed-function proof and explicit cap acceptance.
